core_idea: Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 3 Rupture (max +2); Coin Power +1 per 7 (Rupture + Rupture Count) (max +5). Support passive (**Lingering Resolve ['''餘桓''']**) keys off **deployment order** — set your main carry as #1 deployed before the fight. **Heishou substitute** — if this unit is **killed**, the backup that **Substitutes** in gains Combat Start Poise.
playstyle_guide:
- **Lingering Resolve ['''餘桓''']** watches the **#1 deployed ally** — arrange the dashboard so the intended carry is first in line.
- Chain Battles only — each Sinner equips **one identity**; queue backup **Sinners** in deployment order. This passive procs on **death**, not Stagger.
- Skills check **4+ Rupture** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Crimson Spring** — **S1 — Crimson Strike** adds **+3 Poise** on **Clash Win**; **S2 — Crimson Phoenix** adds **Poise** equal to Rupture on target on **On Hit**.
- **Crimson Spring** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- Build Launcher — 始 — Count — spend via S3 once you hit 3+.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 3 Rupture (max +2).
- Hold S3 for when At 3+ Launcher — 始 — is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Crimson Strike** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Coin Power** scales with **Rupture** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.

*↳ Alternate S1 — Crimson Strike - Launcher ['''始''']* (BP 2, CP +2): rolls — low 2, high 6 (Extremely Low).
  - Gain 5 Poise and +2 Poise Count
  - At 3+ Ready — 待 —, Coin Power +2
  - Consume all Ready — 待 — on self to gain +(Ready — 待 — on self x 2) Atk Weight (max 5)

**S2 — Crimson Phoenix** (BP 2, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 2, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Delay until 4+ Rupture on target — that is when the damage condition activates.
- Inflict +1 Rupture Count; [On Crit] Inflict 1 Defense Level Down next turn
- Gain Poise equal to Rupture on target (max 5); [Heads Hit] Gain Poise Count equal to Rupture Count on target (max 3)
- Deal +(20 + Poise on self + Rupture on target)% damage on Critical Hit (max 50%); [On Crit Kill Against Enemy] Gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn (once per turn)

**S3 — Crimson Spring** (BP 8, CP +14, x1): rolls — low 8, high 22 (Extremely High / Slightly High stacked).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Rupture + Rupture Count)** (+1 per 7, max +5) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- C1 refunds +2 Poise Count

Combat passive — **Launching Maneuver ['''始動''']**: Upon Retreat: apply 1 Offense Level Up next turn to allies in their Deployment order.
  - Number of affected allies <nowiki>=</nowiki> Launcher — 始 — Stack on self.
  - If the affected ally is a "Jia Family" unit, apply 2 Offense Level Up next turn instead.

Combat passive — **Rupture-breathing Resolve ['''破吸自桓''']**: When killing the target with this unit's Attack Skills, gain Poise equal to Rupture on target (3 per 1 enemy.
  - once per turn).
  - If this unit gained 3 Poise with the above effect, gain Poise Count equal to Rupture Count on target (2 per 1 enemy.

Defense skill — **Evade: Adept Evasion**: [Combat Start] At 3+ Launcher — 始 —, perform a Battlefield Retreat at Turn End.
  - Upon Retreat, move to the frontmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (Returns first before the other Backup units Substitute in).
  - [On Use] Gain +1 Poise Count (2 times per turn).
  - [On Evade] Gain 2 Poise (2 times per turn).
